units.source_text: 此诗并不十分出色，但匂亲王认为是他所想念的那个女子所咏的，

en.t: This poem was not especially outstanding, but Prince Niou believed it had been composed by the woman he longed for,

units.source_text: 看到了很注目，对二女公子说道：“你写回信给她吧。

en.t: and when he saw it, it caught his attention. He said to the Second Princess, “Write her a reply.
You must not be so terribly cold any longer.

units.source_text: 其实这种信不须隐藏，你又何必生气呢！

en.t: In fact, there is no need to hide this kind of letter, so why should you be angry?
Very well, I shall go over there myself.”

units.source_text: 匂亲王去后，二女公子悄悄地对少将君说：“这件事弄糟了！

en.t: After Prince Niou left, the Second Princess quietly said to Shosho no Kimi, “This has gone badly!

units.source_text: 东西交给这小孩，怎么你们都没看见？”

en.t: The thing was handed to this child. How did none of you see it?”

units.source_text: 少将君说：“我们倘看见，怎么会让她送到亲王那里去呢！

en.t: Shosho no Kimi said, “If we had seen it, how could we have let her take it to the prince?

units.source_text: 这孩子老是无心无思，多嘴多舌。

en.t: This child is always thoughtless and talks too much.

units.source_text: 一个人是从小看大的，小时候谨慎小心，大起来才会好呢。”

en.t: You can tell what a person will become from childhood; only if one is cautious and careful when young will one turn out well after growing up.”
The Second Princess said, “Let it be!
Do not blame this child anymore!”

units.source_text: 这女童是去年冬天有一个人推荐来的，相貌很漂亮，匂亲王也很喜欢她。

en.t: This little girl had been recommended by someone the previous winter; she was very pretty, and Prince Niou was also quite fond of her.
